title: Rooftop Run
script:
Monsoon night over Old Mumbai. MAYA RAO (19), a wiry courier with a high black bun skewered by a pencil, a faded red kurta over cargo pants and a cracked leather satchel, sprints across the tin rooftops with a stolen ledger. A thin scar cuts through her left eyebrow.

She is chased by THE TAILOR, a tall enforcer in a charcoal three-piece suit and a white porcelain half-mask, who carries a folded umbrella with a hooked steel tip.

Maya leaps a gap between buildings and nearly slips on the wet tin. The Tailor doesn't jump; he hooks a clothesline with his umbrella and swings across. Maya: "Oh, come ON." She ducks under hanging laundry, kicks a stack of water drums down a ladder behind her (CLANG CLANG CLANG) and drops through a skylight into a crowded textile workshop, landing on a bolt of silk. The Tailor appears at the skylight above, rain pouring past his mask. The Tailor: "Nobody outruns the cut, little courier." Maya smiles, holding up the ledger's brass lotus lock — it's empty. Maya: "Who said I'm the one running?"
checks: Readable action: clear left-to-right screen direction for the chase across both pages.
Maya's bun + pencil, red kurta, satchel and eyebrow scar stay identical; the Tailor's mask, suit and hooked umbrella stay identical.
Establishing shot when the scene moves into the workshop.
Shot variety: no more than two same-size shots in a row.
SFX are left for overlay (no drawn lettering); page 1 ends on a hook.
